Last Wednesday, Tom and Mia went to the river bank. Tom learned a lot about science. Both of them like soup and juice. For example, petals fell like pink snow.
Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises. Tom plays chess with Mia every Wednesday. A small stream runs behind the house.
Tom and Mia had great fun there. Tom drinks juice after doing sports. Tom is reading a book about science. What's more, camels carry people across the desert.
Tom hopes to visit Toronto one day. There are always many people at the flower market. Tom thinks science is interesting but a little difficult.
